obligations.expected_behavior: Prevent success when identity or execution facts are unknown, missing, stale, ambiguous, or unverifiable.
forbidden_result: Reporting or treating the operation as successful while any required identity or execution fact is unknown, missing, stale, ambiguous, or unverifiable.
obligations.observable_result: The operation cannot reach a success outcome unless required identity and execution facts are known, present, current, unambiguous, and verifiable.
obligations.state_after: All required identity and execution facts supporting success are known, present, current, unambiguous, and verifiable.
obligations.state_before: One or more required identity or execution facts may be unknown, missing, stale, ambiguous, or unverifiable.
obligations.subject: Success determination
obligations.trigger: An operation is evaluated for success.
